intro: Detroit pairs a bathhouse that has been open to guests since 1930 with a newer wave of wood-fired and Finnish-style saunas. The Schvitz in the North End takes walk-ins on a weekly schedule of all-gender, men-only and women-only hours, BASK in Brush Park sells two-hour sauna and cold plunge sessions, and two outdoor operations, Islandview Sauna Club and SOMi Sauna on Belle Isle, run wood-fired saunas on weekends. Prices, hours and seasonal dates change, so confirm with each venue before you go.

venues.name: The Schvitz
venues.session_length: Stay for the session (Sunday sessions are separate, so re-entry between them is paid)
venues.schedule: Everyone welcome (bathing suits required): Mon & Fri 12pm-10pm, Sat 11am-4pm, Sun 6pm-10pm. Men only (suits optional): Sun 7am-11am, Wed 12pm-10pm, Thu 4pm-10pm. Women only (suits optional): Sat 7am-11am, Sun 12pm-4pm, Tue 12pm-10pm. Walk-ins only; no reservations for public hours.
venues.notes: Historic bathhouse with two saunas heated to 180-200°F, showers, a pool, common areas and an outdoor patio. Admission includes a locker and towels. Robe rental $5 (limited supply); sandals $15 and locks $10 for sale, or bring your own. No hot tub. Outside food not permitted; there is a house kitchen. Saturday evenings after 6pm are reserved for private parties.

venues.name: BASK Detroit
venues.drop_in_price: $60 one-time visit; 3-pass package $160; 10-pass package $380; memberships from $180/month
venues.schedule: Mon-Sat 7am-9pm. Co-ed communal sauna and plunge areas with separate men's and women's locker rooms. Booking ahead recommended; walk-ins if space allows.
venues.notes: Community Finnish dry sauna for up to 40 people, set to 194°F (170-200°F depending on bench level). Bring modest swimwear; lockers, towels and showers provided. Cashless. Paid parking structure plus street parking nearby. Rinse before using the plunge tubs.

venues.name: Islandview Sauna Club
venues.drop_in_price: Unknown (booked by the hour online; price not shown on the venue's pages)
venues.schedule: Fri 5pm-9pm, Sat 1pm-5pm, Sun 1pm-5pm. Book online; private groups of 6+ use the contact form. You must wear something in the sauna.
venues.notes: Three custom wood-fired saunas (a converted cattle trailer, a converted horse trailer and a barrel sauna) on a wooded former rail corridor, plus a campfire and a heated base tent for changing with non-secure storage. Portable restroom on site. Arrive 15 minutes early for safety guidelines. Bring a robe or towel, a swimsuit, a towel to sit on, sandals and a water bottle; leave jewelry and valuables at home.

venues.name: SOMi Sauna at Belle Isle Beach
venues.address: Belle Isle Beach, just west of the Beach House, Detroit, MI
venues.cold_plunge: Detroit River (or cool off in open air)
venues.schedule: Select weekends, October through January: Nov 14-15, Nov 28-29, Dec 12-13 2026; Jan 16-17, Jan 30-31 2027. Seven sessions a day from 10am to the last start at 7pm, ten seats each. 18+. Runs in snow and rain; cancelled only for lightning or unsafe ice.
venues.notes: Hand-built cedar trailer sauna with a wood-fired stove, 180-205°F, two tiers of benches. Bring a swimsuit (wear it under your clothes) and a towel. Free parking in the beach lot. Cancel more than 48 hours ahead for a full refund.
